en.description:
Takismana (タキスマナ) is a voicebank for the UTAU program. A mysterious pilot of alien origin, she navigates the cosmos in her ship, the ''Iris'', accompanied by her best friend – a glass spider Garasu Kumo (ガラス蜘蛛). Takismana’s voice is designed to be clear and expressive, capable of both soft, introspective tones and strong, confident ones. It carries a subtle otherworldly resonance, fitting her alien background. Takismana has a slender build. Her eyes are always hidden behind large, opaque pilot goggles that reflect the stars. Her most striking features are the spiral ******* and the dinosaur‑like ridges along her back. She wears a turquoise pilot’s jumpsuit and a matching helmet in a retro‑space style. She also has a katana, but doesn’t wear it all the time, for necessities only.
Please find the technical information in the voicebank readme file.

en.description:
Iirai is a 25‑year‑old entity who looks like a guy but behaves more like a wayward project file that climbed out of Eli’s hard drive. His voice lives in the low register, warm and slightly ominous, the kind of bass that feels like it is humming inside bones rather than just in headphones. On stage and in covers, he comes across as hyperactive, talkative, and constantly grinning, but when he actually sings, something older and ritual-like slips through the cracks of his phrasing.
People who meet Iirai get a double impression: visually, he is warm, freckled, and chaotic in a harmless way; sonically, his bass feels like a distant ritual echoing under an empty stage. Eli is the only one who can fully negotiate with him when those scissors hover over something important, which is why Iirai tends to stay close to Eli’s projects and recordings. Iirai jokes that he is “what happens when a voicebank refuses to stay inside its own folder,” and no one has managed to prove him wrong.

description.en: イーライ (Iirai) – evokes the sound of a stretched “Eli” and the idea of a delayed echo, like a voice arriving late from a metal tunnel.
